description: This file defines the SearchQuery class in the SuiteCRM's search module, providing functionalities to construct, manipulate, and serialize search query objects. It supports creating search queries from strings, arrays, and GET requests, with options for pagination, engine selection, and module filtering.

classes.name: SearchQuery
classes.description: A class representing a search query with methods to initialize from various sources, manipulate query parameters, and serialize for external use.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a SearchQuery object from a search string, with optional size, from, engine, options, and modules for pagination and customization.

methods.name: fromRequestArray
methods.description: Constructs a SearchQuery object from an array, typically a request payload, extracting relevant search parameters.

methods.name: fromGetRequest
methods.description: Creates a SearchQuery object from the global $_GET array, representing URL query parameters.

methods.name: getFrom
methods.description: Returns the offset from which search results start.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of search results to retrieve.

methods.name: getDefaultEngine
methods.description: Determines and returns the default search engine based on configuration.

methods.name: getDefaultSearchSize
methods.description: Returns the default number of search results per query based on configuration.

methods.name: getEngine
methods.description: Returns the search engine being used for the current query.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves a specific search option by key.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns all search options associated with this query.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether the search query string is empty.

methods.name: getSearchString
methods.description: Returns the search query string.

methods.name: toLowerCase
methods.description: Converts the search query string to lowercase.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the search query string.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces occurrences of one substring with another in the search query string.

methods.name: stripSlashes
methods.description: Removes escape slashes from the search query string.

methods.name: escapeRegex
methods.description: Escapes special regex characters in the search query string.

methods.name: convertEncoding
methods.description: Converts HTML entities in the search query to UTF-8 characters.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the SearchQuery object to an array, following JSON serialization interface.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Returns the list of modules to be searched.
